newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme and Pharming settle license dispute.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme and Pharming settle license dispute.

text.p: Genzyme Transgenics Corp said Thursday that it has ended arbitration proceedings with Pharming BV, a privately held Dutch biotechnology concern, that both companies had filed under a 1994 Cross- License Agreement between them.

In ending the arbitration, both companies said that they had amended the Cross-License Agreement to clarify the terms under which Genzyme may work in transgenic cattle, and Pharming may work in transgenic goats, when using the cross-licensed patents.

In addition to clarifying the terms under which Genzyme Transgenics and Pharming, respectively, may work in transgenic cattle and goats, the amended Cross-License Agreement also clarifies the terms under which certain royalites will be paid.

Pharming is a European company aimed at production and commercialization of human health care products from milk. Genzyme uses transgenic technology to develop recombinant proteins and monoclonal antibodies.
